technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (stoch 92, Williams %R) and weak ADX trend strength create elevated pullback risk; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops or on pullback confirmation.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 41 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (42/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (49.8%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (579+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (407.8), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 41 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend and PSAR bullish alignment provides structural support for swing entry, especially in fear-zone market conditions offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic (92.05) and Williams %R combined with weak ADX (14.9), zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro environment, and earnings risk in 41 days create excessive pullback/reversal risk that outweighs technical setup strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major MAs and positive momentum alignment, but overbought conditions (stoch 92, Williams %R) at near-resistance pricing severely limit entry quality.
